description: List the matches an alert has caught, newest first — the payoff of an alert. Each match names the watched entity and the podcast episode it was detected on (with episode and podcast slugs that feed particle_podcast_get_episode and particle_podcast_resolve). Use view=detailed to include the transcript excerpts around each mention, and after/before to scope to a date range. Backfilled matches (from the past-week sweep at creation) are flagged and never triggered an email.

after.description: Only matches detected on or after this ISO date (e.g. 2026-05-01).

alert_id.description: Alert id whose matches to list.

before.description: Only matches detected on or before this ISO date.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor from a previous response's cursor field.

output_format.description: Output serialization. 'markdown' (default) returns the LLM-facing rendering. 'json' returns the structured payload as JSON text — use only for programmatic chaining where exact field extraction matters; the JSON shape is larger and noisier for an LLM to read.

view.description: Detail level. 'summary' (default) returns each match's entity, episode, and counts. 'detailed' also includes the transcript excerpt windows around each mention.

name: particle_alert_list_matches
